items.exampleEn: Gender doesn't matter for this job.
Our host made us a big dinner.
items.exampleZh: 招待我們的主人為我們做了一頓豐盛的晚餐。

items.exampleEn: I spent my childhood in Tainan.
items.exampleZh: 我的童年是在台南度過的。

items.exampleEn: We went to my cousin's wedding last week.
items.exampleZh: 我們上週去參加了我表哥的婚禮。

items.exampleEn: My son is a teenager now.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子現在是青少年了。

items.exampleEn: Don't open the door to strangers.
He is a big music lover.
We should help elderly people on the bus.
items.exampleZh: 我們在公車上應該幫助年長者。

items.sentenceEn: I had a very happy childhood.
items.sentenceZh: 我有一個很快樂的童年。

items.audioEn: Our host showed us around the city and took us to a night market.
items.audioZh: 接待我們的主人帶我們逛了城市，還帶我們去夜市。

items.sentenceEn: When I was a teenager, I wanted to be a singer.
items.sentenceZh: 我十幾歲的時候想當歌手。

items.sentenceEn: A stranger asked me for help.

items.stemEn: There are special seats for ____ people on the bus.
items.stemZh: 公車上有給年長者坐的特別座位。

items.stemEn: Mia is a book ____. She reads every day.
items.stemZh: Mia 很愛看書，她每天都在讀書。

items.passageEn: When I was a teenager, I lived with a host family in Japan for a month. My host was an elderly woman who loved cooking. At first I felt like a stranger, but she soon made me feel like part of her family. Last spring, she invited me to her granddaughter's wedding. It felt like going home.
items.passageZh: 我十幾歲的時候，在日本的寄宿家庭住了一個月。接待我的是一位很愛做菜的老太太。一開始我覺得自己像個陌生人，但她很快就讓我覺得自己是她家的一份子。去年春天，她邀請我去參加她孫女的婚禮。那感覺就像回家一樣。

questions.questionZh: 作者青少年時期在日本住在哪裡？
主人去年春天邀請作者做什麼？

items.promptZh: 請在這裡寫上你的性別和年齡。
referenceEn: Please write your gender and age here.
Please write down your gender and age here.
rubricZh: 請求句用原形動詞開頭（例如 Please write…、Please fill in…）

items.instructionZh: 用 wedding 造一個句子，說說你參加過的一場婚禮。
referenceEn: My best friend's wedding was very romantic.
My cousin's wedding was in a beautiful garden.
rubricZh: wedding 是名詞「婚禮」（例如 my friend's wedding）
說過去的事用過去式（例如 went、was）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：正解是唯一形容詞、只靠詞性可選；改四選項同詞性
執行長第②③關裁示修正：選項釋義同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["已婚的","有錢的","年長的","十幾歲的"]（原 ["性別","陌生人","年長的","愛好者"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：題目問「作者去年春天為什麼去日本？」，但短文只說主人邀請作者參加孫女婚禮、"It felt like going home"，沒有明說作者去了日本或婚禮在日本；建議短文補一句（例如 So I flew to Japan again.）或改問「主人去年春天邀請作者做什麼？」。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "主人去年春天邀請作者做什麼？"（原 "作者去年春天為什麼去日本？"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：選項同步（正解位置不變）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["去她家讀書","參加她孫女的婚禮","去她家工作"]（原 ["去讀書","參加婚禮","去工作"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 FIX：childhood 情境句與單字卡雷同
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "I had a very happy childhood."（原 "I spent my childhood by the sea."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：中譯同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "我有一個很快樂的童年。"（原 "我的童年是在海邊度過的。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示：正解長度均衡：干擾項補細節，意思仍與短文不符
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "去她家住一個月讀書"（原 "去她家讀書"）
